featured_reviews.name: Suprabha Keshava Ram Bonanthaya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our recent trip with Navkar Travels was extremely stressful and disappointing due to poor planning, lack of accountability, and constant justification instead of solutions.

Before the trip, we specifically asked Mr. Sidharth whether we should take VIP tickets for temple visits. He clearly advised that there was no need. Because of this incorrect guidance, at Bhimashankar we were unable to visit the temple at all, which was a major disappointment. Later, this was explained away as “rush due to closure,” rather than taking responsibility. This became a pattern—every concern was met with reasons, not resolutions.

The itinerary planning was careless. Ellora was included in our plan, but Navkar Travels failed to cross-check closure days, and when we reached, Ellora was closed, resulting in a complete miss of the visit. Such basic planning errors are unacceptable from a professional travel operator.

Although proper coordination was promised, there was no regular communication from their side. Despite multiple issues throughout the journey, we had to keep following up repeatedly.

Accommodation Experience

To be fair, rooms at Pune and Ahilyanagar were good and comfortable.

However, at Nashik and Aurangabad, accommodation was arranged through OYO, and the experience there was very poor:
•	Unhygienic rooms with cockroaches
•	Torn bed sheets and foul-smelling pillows
•	Dirty toilets
•	No hot water
•	Lift not working
•	At one location, no bed was arranged for our children, despite clearly informing them that kids were travelling with us. Only after repeated calls was some arrangement managed.

Vehicle & Travel Issues
•	We had to wake the driver every morning to start the day’s travel
•	The bus had exposed nails in the luggage area, due to which two of our luggage bags got torn
•	Instead of accepting responsibility, we were blamed for carrying “big luggage”
•	We were 8 members travelling for 8 days—expecting backpacks is unrealistic
•	Due to fear of further damage, luggage had to be kept inside the seating area
•	Seat cushioning was very poor and uncomfortable

On the positive side, the driver was not an alcoholic or smoker, which we appreciated. Also, the AC in the bus worked well, which genuinely helped us cope during the journey.

Serious Documentation Concern

One very serious issue was with road transport documentation. During a highway check, we discovered that the documents were issued under someone else’s name, not related to our trip. Thankfully, the officer did not cross-check further. Otherwise, we could have faced major legal trouble, despite no fault of ours. This was extremely concerning and unacceptable.

Overall

For a family travelling with children and elders, this level of mismanagement, hygiene issues, poor coordination, and documentation risk is unacceptable. The experience did not justify the money spent or the trust placed in Navkar Travels.

I hope this review helps future travellers make an informed decision and encourages Navkar Travels to focus on professionalism, safety, and genuine customer care instead of explanations for every failure.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Ms. Suprabha,

Greetings from Navkar Travels !!!

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We sincerely regret that your experience did not meet your expectations, and we would like to place certain facts on record for clarity and transparency, especially for future travellers reviewing our page.

Tour Planning & Communication :
The entire tour was planned, discussed, approved, and confirmed by your husband, Mr. Keshava Ram Bonanthaya. All proposals, hotel names, vehicle details, inclusions, and exclusions were shared clearly with him well in advance, and approvals were received accordingly. During the journey, we remained in constant communication with you, providing route guidance, coordination, and daily support to ensure smooth travel.

Temple Visits & VIP Darshan :
As clearly mentioned in our tour exclusions, temple entry fees and VIP darshan tickets are to be arranged directly by guests. When you inquired shortly before departure, you were informed that VIP tickets are generally not mandatory and that you were free to book them independently if preferred.
The Bhimashankar situation arose due to sudden crowd escalation following public news of temple renovation, a factor beyond our control. We regret the inconvenience, but this was not a result of misinformation or negligence.

Sightseeing Closures :
Ellora Caves closure occurred as per ASI regulations. While we strive to cross-check schedules, monument closures can change due to government notifications, strikes, or local conditions. Such unforeseen closures are industry-wide limitations and are mentioned in our standard terms.

Accommodation Selection :
Initially, 4-star branded hotels were proposed. Due to budget constraints conveyed by your husband, the package was revised multiple times at his request. Eventually, average-category hotels were selected with full disclosure of hotel names and categories, and approval was received before booking.
We always recommend hotels based on guest comfort, but final decisions are made as per the client’s budget preferences.

Vehicle & Driver Support :
A 13-seater AC luxury vehicle was provided for 6 adults and 2 children, offering ample seating comfort. Oversized luggage (full-size trolley bags for all guests) was not pre-informed. Despite this, we accommodated luggage to the best possible extent. The damage reported occurred due to forceful placement of oversized bags in the luggage compartment.
Regarding route familiarity, our team actively guided the driver daily and shared navigation links to ensure a smooth journey.

Documentation Concern :
We take this point seriously and have already escalated it with our transport partner. Necessary corrective measures have been initiated to ensure stricter verification going forward.

Our Service Record :
Navkar Travels proudly holds 338+ reviews, with over 99% rated 5-star only a few rated 4-star, reflecting consistent service quality, trust, and professionalism built over years in the travel industry. While we respect every client’s feedback, we believe expectations must align with the category of services selected.

In Closing :
We regret that your experience did not align with your expectations and genuinely appreciate the positives you acknowledged. However, it is important to note that the package delivered was strictly as per confirmed inclusions, approved hotels, and agreed budget parameters.

We remain committed to improving continuously and delivering transparent, honest travel solutions to all our clients.

Warm regards,
Siddharth J Mehta
Head Operations 
Navkar Travels Pvt Ltd
